name: EDEN.schemata();
source:
"Nice to meet you... again?"
An android named "Eve" speaks to "you", before a headless corpse apparently known as "The Professor".

Completely devoid of any sort of memory, "you",　together with "Eve" – an android, and the Professor's apparent killer – must uncover the truth of what really happened here.

Use your powers of deduction to unravel the mystery of this sealed laboratory, one revelation after another.

EDEN.schemata(); is a multi-ending sci-fi mystery adventure game, featuring headless corpses, a sealed laboratory, a limbless android suspect/heroine, and an amnesiac protagonist.
The game design and gradually UI change in reflection of your actions.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1630450/EDENschemata/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“很高兴再次见到你……？”
一个名为“伊芙”的机器人在一具显然被称为“教授”的无头尸体前与“你”说话。

完全没有任何记忆的“你”，和“伊芙”——一个机器人，也是杀害教授的明显凶手——必须揭开这里真正发生的事情的真相。

运用你的推理能力，揭开这个密封实验室的神秘面纱，一个又一个的启示。

EDEN.schemata();是一款多结局科幻悬疑冒险游戏，以无头尸体、密封实验室、无肢机器人嫌疑人/女主角和失忆症主角为特色。
游戏设计和UI会根据你的操作而逐渐发生变化。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1630450/EDENschemata/]Steam[/url]]
